nodes.label: Snyk High Risk rating (false positive)
nodes.rationale: Snyk flags caveman-compress High Risk via static analysis heuristics because it calls subprocess.run() (fallback to the `claude` CLI when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is unset) and does file read/write. This is treated as a false positive: the subprocess call uses a fixed argument list with no shell interpolation and no shell=True, user file content is passed via stdin rather than as a shell argument, only the user-specified path is read/written (plus a .original.md backup), no data is transmitted beyond the file being compressed, and files over 500KB are rejected before any API call is made.

nodes.label: Auto-clarity rule
nodes.rationale: Caveman compression is dropped in favor of normal prose for security warnings, irreversible-action confirmations, multi-step sequences where fragment order or omitted conjunctions risk misreading, and whenever compression itself creates ambiguity (e.g. an unordered destructive migrate/drop/backup instruction) — because in those cases the token savings are not worth the risk of a misread instruction. Caveman resumes once the clear/critical part has been communicated.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Expansion (Vocab Matching)
nodes.rationale: The query CLI matches nodes via case-folded substring + IDF with no stemming/synonyms/cross-language match, so a literal question in different vocabulary than the graph's labels returns zero hits; expanding the query against the actual graph vocabulary first (without inventing tokens) fixes this.

nodes.label: Graphify Work Memory (Self-Improving Loop)
nodes.rationale: save-result with --outcome useful|dead_end|corrected lets future sessions learn from prior query/path/explain runs; graphify reflect --if-stale refreshes LESSONS.md cheaply and deterministically without an LLM call.

nodes.label: Whisper Domain-Hint Prompt Strategy
nodes.rationale: Compose a one-sentence domain hint from the top god-node labels already available (no extra API call) and pass it to Whisper as the initial prompt to improve transcription of domain-specific terms.

nodes.label: No Speculative Generality Principle
nodes.rationale: Don't build the plugin system, theme engine, or i18n layer until a second real use case exists; a config object in content/site.config.ts is the ceiling of abstraction here.

nodes.label: ponytail: Comment Marker Convention
nodes.rationale: Mark deliberate simplifications with a `ponytail:` comment naming the ceiling and upgrade path (e.g. global lock, O(n^2) scan) so a shortcut reads as intent, not ignorance.

nodes.label: Content Layer vs Component Layer Split
nodes.rationale: The storefront is deliberately split into a content layer (edit freely) and a component layer (rarely touch), so nearly every business request becomes a content-layer edit and components never hardcode copy/prices/image URLs.
nodes.norm_label: content layer vs component layer split

nodes.label: bcrypt (Password Hashing)
nodes.rationale: Used directly rather than via passlib; password hashing and JWT are security primitives that must never be hand-rolled.

nodes.label: qrcode (Coupon QR Codes)
nodes.rationale: python-barcode is EAN13/UPCA numeric-only, the wrong shape for an alphanumeric coupon code; qrcode reuses Pillow, already a dependency.

nodes.label: textstat (Readability Scoring)
nodes.rationale: Depends on pkg_resources, which recent setuptools no longer ships; setuptools is pinned below 81 so the optional textstat path keeps working.

nodes.label: python-multipart
nodes.rationale: Required at runtime (not import time) by Starlette's UploadFile/Form parsing; its absence goes unnoticed until an actual multipart request arrives, needed for the media-library upload endpoint.

nodes.label: description_analyzer service
nodes.rationale: Falls back to a self-contained Flesch approximation if the optional textstat dependency is unavailable.

nodes.label: Caddy-Only Port Publishing Policy
nodes.rationale: Docker's port publishing writes iptables rules ahead of ufw, so any `ports:` mapping is reachable from the public internet regardless of ufw settings; only caddy publishes to the host, everything else talks over the private compose network by service name.

nodes.label: media_uploads Volume
nodes.rationale: Persists media-library uploads (app/routers/media.py) on disk so a container rebuild doesn't wipe uploaded images.
